about_the_game:
Fight to Save Animals

Battle AI robots to rescue adorable animals trapped in dungeons. Each victory brings new furry allies to your side, helping you grow stronger and expand your base to take on even greater threats.

Each animal has it's own ability

Every rescued animal can contribute to enhancing your base. From item transporting sugar gliders to stone collecting hedgehogs, their abilities shape your strategy and improve your crafting efficiency.

Collect special skills

Find powerful skills hidden throughout dungeons. Unleash explosive ranged attacks, wear down enemies with deadly damage over time (DoT), and adapt your strategy with every find. The right skill at the right moment could turn the tide of battle!

Build your base for crafting

Strategically design your crafting system by placing workshops and storage boxes wisely. A well-planned base lets your rescued animals craft powerful weapons and shields faster, helping you gear up quickly to save even more animals.

name: Mighty Meow Demo
short_description: Mighty Meow is an action RPG with base-building. Rescue adorable animals from dungeons overrun by evil AI robots. While you are fighting relentless foes, your furry friends will be crafting powerful gear for you back at your base. Explore dangerous dungeons, manage resources and expand your base.
supported_languages: English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
